name: Lanyard
description: Interactive 3D hanging ID card on a woven strap with metal clamp and ring, rendered in WebGL with a custom physics simulation. Drag to swing the card, click to flip between front and back images.
contents: Rounded card with slot, front and back faces from images or a solid color
Woven strap with metal clamp, eyelet and ring
behavior: Card and strap swing with simulated gravity, damping, elasticity and a gentle breeze
Drag the card to pull it around, releasing lets it swing back
A quick click or tap flips the card to its other side
Optional intro where the card drops in and settles
Rendering pauses when offscreen, the tab is hidden, or the card has come to rest with no breeze
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by disabling intro and breeze
Resizes with its container and cleans up renderer, textures and listeners on unmount
editableByProps: Front, back and strap images, image fit, card and strap colors
Card orientation, corner radius, finish, hardware metal
Card size, horizontal anchor, strap length and width
Physics feel: gravity, damping, elasticity, breeze
Dragging and intro animation on or off, container size through className or style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card dimensions or aspect ratio

needsCodeEdit.where: buildEnvironment function and keyLight and fillLight in the useEffect

needsCodeEdit.change: Change flip speed or click time threshold
needsCodeEdit.where: FLIP_SPIN constant and flip function, 450ms check in onPointerUp

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the number of anchor positions

fixed: Requires WebGL, renders nothing if the renderer cannot be created
Root fills its parent with w-full h-full, so the parent must have a defined height or the canvas collapses
Transparent canvas, no background is drawn
Canvas is aria-hidden and has no text alternative
Pointer events on the canvas are captured while dragging and touch-action is pan-y when interactive, so vertical page scroll still works outside the card
Pixel ratio is capped at 2 and face textures are 1024px wide
Card images loaded from other origins must allow CORS, otherwise they are skipped
Camera framing keeps the card at least 72 percent of the width, so it scales down on narrow containers and works on mobile
Strap is always rendered in a fixed single-clamp design with 4 physics joints

options.look: Shiny plastic card with clear coat reflections
options.useWhen: Event badge or conference pass on a hero where a clean, modern card is wanted
Minimal or editorial team page where the card artwork should read without glare

options.look: Rainbow foil shimmer and sparkle that shifts as the card moves
options.useWhen: Product launch, membership or collectible style hero that should feel special

options.look: Brushed metal card with anisotropic highlights
options.useWhen: Premium or tech brand VIP pass section
